# Ideator Labs

> Ideator Labs is a studio at the intersection of AI and data advisory, innovation and business intelligence: we help businesses use AI and data to decide better, and build the tools and products that make it happen.

Sectors we work in today: retail (FurniTrail), B2B companies and agencies (PollenRev), accounting and CA firms, D2C brands, clinics and healthcare practices, finance, manufacturing, and logistics and supply chain; advisory in every sector. Next sectors are picked one at a time.

## Products

- [Products](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/): Overview of what Ideator Labs builds and researches.
- [FurniTrail by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/furnitrail/): Customer journey software for furniture showrooms. Tagline: From browsing to belonging. For the buyer who says "we'll come back with family": they get one page in the showroom's own name with the pieces they liked (shortlist), then a proposal they can accept, then their order on its way, then delivery and a thank-you that asks for a review, plus a page to refer a friend. Every morning the showroom team's Today list shows who needs them. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [PollenRev](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/pollenrev/): PollenRev is sales software for small and mid-sized businesses. It finds leads on Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Google search, Instagram and LinkedIn, scores them against your ideal customer, writes outreach, proposals and pitch decks in your brand’s voice, and tracks each deal in a sales pipeline. Book a demo through the contact page.

## Advisory

- [Advisory](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/solutions/): Starts with a free 25-minute call, then a fixed-fee diagnostic that finds where a business loses time or margin and what to fix first, then an optional build. Method: VALUE OS (Baseline, Diagnose, Quantify, Design, Drive). If the diagnostic finds nothing worth fixing, we say so plainly. Fees are not published.
- [Sectors](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/industries/): The sectors we work in today and how to suggest the next one.

## Blog

- [Ideator Labs blog](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/): Plain-language articles on AI, data engineering, business intelligence and the sectors we work in. Every fact sourced and dated.
- [How we write](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/how-we-write/): How articles are researched, checked and corrected.
- [CA and accounting firms](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/ca-firms/): Where accounting practices lose hours to matching, re-typing and chasing, and how to win them back.
- [D2C brands](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/d2c/): The real margin on each order, after returns, shipping, fees and ads.
- [FurniTrail](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/furnitrail/): For furniture showroom owners: turning walk-in visitors into buyers with timely, personal follow-up.
- [Where CA firms lose hours every week, and how AI gives them back](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/ca-firms-reclaim-hours-with-ai.html): The time goes into data work, not advice. Here is where it hides and how to win it back one task at a time.
- [Your D2C brand’s real problem isn’t ads, it’s true margin per order](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/d2c-true-margin-per-order.html): Before you change the ads, find out what each order really leaves you with.
- [Why furniture showrooms lose walk-in buyers, and how to follow up](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/furnitrail/furniture-showroom-walk-in-follow-up.html): What to capture at the door, what to send, and when.

## Company

- [About](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/about/): Who Ideator Labs is and how it works.
- [Research](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/research/): What we are researching: CORTEX and YAMCP (open source) and Brain (experiments toward an open-source, brain-inspired AI companion, drawing on existing neuroscience and AI research; research, not a product).
- [Open source](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/open-source/): CORTEX, a public repository that includes YAMCP, a Model Context Protocol server framework; and five Python packages: Greenline (WhatsApp Cloud API engine), TillSync (POS and spreadsheet connectors), Nudgewright (personal customer message lines with reasons), Faultbell (exception alerts and server watch, to chat, paging and email) and Leadbell (website lead capture with consent, plus sign-up, lead and payment alerts).
